stations.District: chart-dist, chart-nn, chart-hist, kpi:districts, insight:lead_district, insight:density, table:directory
stations.Regional_Station: chart-reg, insight:top_regional, table:directory, map-stations, key:hq — district HQ rows are marked by a regional name starting with מב"ת
stations.Station: chart-iso, table:directory, map-stations, insight:recent, insight:isolated — station names; matched across snapshots for added/removed
stations.Station_Type: chart-dist, kpi:regional, kpi:sub, insight:sub_share, key:hq — מחוז/מטה rows are headquarters, not stations
stations.Address: table:directory, map-stations, chart-city — the locality name a city code's addresses share labels the localities chart
stations.Street: skip: duplicates the street part of Address, which the directory shows in full
stations.Location: table:directory, map-stations — free-text location hint (junction, industrial zone)
stations.PhoneNumber: text:lede — the service line (*4964), the same for every row
stations.Geo_Lat: map-stations, chart-nn, chart-iso, kpi:nn — WGS84 latitude (2026 file onward)
stations.Geo_Lon: map-stations, chart-nn, chart-iso, kpi:nn — WGS84 longitude (2026 file onward)
stations.Geo_X: map-stations, chart-nn, chart-iso, insight:recent — ITM easting in the 2020-2024 files, converted to WGS84 in compute
stations.Geo_Y: map-stations, chart-nn, chart-iso, insight:recent — ITM northing in the 2020-2024 files
stations.Street_Code: skip: CBS street code, an identifier with no meaning on the page
stations.EmergencyPhoneNumber: kpi:emergency, text:lede — 102, the same for every row
stations.DistrictMail: skip: one generic service mailbox for every row; not repeated on the page
stations._resource_name: chart-hist, insight:growth, key:snapshot — the year in the file name picks the latest snapshot
